# Hugo Narrow 2.1.2

Patch release for the v2 line. Hugo Narrow is no longer maintained; existing sites should stay on their pinned v2 release.

## Fixes

- The dock comments button now appears only on pages that actually render a comments section. Previously the button was shown on every page whenever comments were enabled site-wide. (#94, #95)

## Upgrade

```bash
hugo mod get github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/v2@v2.1.2
```

No configuration changes are required.
